name: Adult cooking classes
summary: How expats book adult cooking classes in Singapore — hawker-inspired home skills, cuisine-specific studios, and condo kitchen constraints.
body:
Adult cooking schools and indie chefs teach knife skills, local favourites, and cuisine tracks (Japanese, Indian, plant-based). Small-group studios dominate; some offer private home sessions when condo kitchens allow.

## Formats
- One-off weekend workshops
- Multi-week fundamentals courses
- Cuisine-specific intensives
- Private couple / team sessions
- Market-tour plus cook formats

Ask whether ingredients and takeaway containers are included.

## How to choose
Prefer classes with clear skill outcomes, not only tasting. Check class size and dietary accommodation. Confirm cancellation rules for peak weekends.

## Practical tip
Wear closed shoes and skip flowing sleeves. Studio kitchens run hot and crowded — comfort beats outfit photos.
